verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R4 mentions that a Vehicle can move for a given time, but this functionality is not represented in the class Vehicle. The method 'move' is only defined in the Vehicle class, and there is no indication that it can take parameters or operate based on time.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a parameter to the 'move' method in the Vehicle class to allow it to operate based on a given time.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R6 states that land vehicles and marine vehicles have all the same features as a Vehicle, but the classes LandVehicle and MarineVehicle do not inherit from Vehicle. They should inherit from Vehicle to ensure they have all the same features.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Inherit the LandVehicle and MarineVehicle classes from the Vehicle class.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R1 states that the system represents different types of vehicles, but there are no use cases defined in the model to represent this functionality.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Define use cases that represent the different types of vehicles and their interactions.
